A health-boosting dish made with leafy greens and a touch of salt.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Salt-Grilled Greens are [[Meal]]s made by [[Cooking]] any [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]] with [[Rock Salt]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their default version can be made by using [[Hyrule Herb]]s, which offer no status effects. Eating these Meals will heal some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. Salt-Grilled Greens are known to be beneficial to one's health, being made with leafy greens and a touch of salt. Based on the type of greens used, Link can make the following variations of Salt Grilled Greens: * '''Hearty Salt-Grilled Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Salt-Grilled Greens}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A health-boosting dish made with leafy greens and a touch of salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Radish]]es, [[Big Hearty Radish]]es, or other hearty [[Ingredient]]s. When eaten, all of Link's Hearts will be healed and he will gain [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Energizing Salt-Grilled Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Salt-Grilled Greens}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A health-boosting dish made with leafy greens and a touch of salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using energizing Ingredients. By eating these greens, part of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] will be refilled. * '''Enduring Salt-Grilled Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Salt-Grilled Greens}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
A health-boosting dish made with leafy greens and a touch of salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Endura Carrot]]s or other enduring Ingredients. These will completely restore and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Salt-Grilled Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Salt-Grilled Greens}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
A health-boosting dish made with leafy greens and a touch of salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Swift Carrot]]s, [[Swift Violet]]s, or other hasty Ingredients. Link can eat them to receive a boost to his movement speed. * '''Spicy Salt-Grilled Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Salt-Grilled Greens}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A health-boosting dish made with leafy greens and a touch of salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Warm Safflina]]s or other spicy Ingredients. If eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Electro Salt-Grilled Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Salt-Grilled Greens}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
A health-boosting dish made with leafy greens and a touch of salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Electric Safflina]]s or other electric Ingredients. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Salt-Grilled Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Salt-Grilled Greens}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
A health-boosting dish made with leafy greens and a touch of salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Mighty Thistle]]s or other mighty Ingredients. Consuming these greens will boost the power of Link's attacks. * '''Tough Salt-Grilled Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Salt-Grilled Greens}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
A health-boosting dish made with leafy greens and a touch of salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Armoranth]]s or other tough Ingredients. Link's defensive abilities will be increased if he eats these. * '''Sneaky Salt-Grilled Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Salt-Grilled Greens}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
A health-boosting dish made with leafy greens and a touch of salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Blue Nightshade]]s, [[Silent Princess]]es, or other sneaky Ingredients. They can be eaten to boost Link's [[Stealth]]. * '''Chilly Salt-Grilled Greens''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Salt-Grilled Greens}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
A health-boosting dish made with leafy greens and a touch of salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Cool Safflina]]s or other chilly Ingredients. When eaten, they will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Like in {{BotW}}, Salt-Grilled Greens are made by [[Cooking]] a piece of [[Rock Salt]] with any kind of [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Copious Fried Wild Greens * Food * Fried Wild Greens * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Salt-Grilled Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
